spans.s: विभ॑क्तृ m. distributer, arranger.
वि॑भक्तृ m. distributer, arranger.

वि॑भक्ति f. division, distinction, modification;
inflection, case, case-affix or personal ending (g.).
विभजनीय a. to be divided.
विभज्य a. to be divided.
विभाज्य a. to be divided or distributed.
विभञ्जनु॑ a. breaking (intr.).

विभय a. dangerless, secure;
 n. as adv.
विभा॑व a. the same.
विभवतस् adv. according to rank or fortune.
विभववन्त् a. wealthy, opulent.
विभ˚विन् a. wealthy, opulent.

विभाविन् a. powerful;
 showing, manifesting, displaying.

विभा॑ a. shining;
 f. lustre, splendour, beauty.
विभागशस् adv. in parts, separately.

विभात a. shone forth, bright, luminous;
 n. daybreak.
†विभानु a. shining, resplendent.
विभा॑वन् a. the same.
विभावनीय a. to be perceived or understood.
विभावरीमुख n. evening (beginning of night).*

विभा॑वसु a. resplendent. m. fire or the god of fire;
the sun.

विभाव्य a. to be perceived, perceivable, intelligible;
to be heeded or attended to (n. impers.).
विभाषा f. alternative, option (g.).
विभाषित a. optional (g.).
विभास् f. splendour.

विभिन्दु॑ a. splitting;
 m. N. of a man.

विभिन्न a. pierced, cleft, opened, blossomed, expanded,
split asunder, destroyed;
 altered, disfigured, estranged, disunited,
opposite, different.

विभी a. fearless;
 m. N. of a man.
1 विभीत a. fearless.
2 विभीत m. = seq.

विभीषणनामक f. ˚मिका a. having a terrible
name.
विभीषिका f. frightening, terror.
विभुत्व n. omnipresence, might, power.

वि॑भूति a. pervading, abundant, powerful, mighty,
disposing of (gen.);
 f. development, growth, abundance, might, power,
glory, majesty, splendour, success, welfare, fortune, prosperity,
wealth, riches.
विभूतिमन्त् a. powerful, mighty.
वि॑भूमन् m. growth, might.
विभू॑वस् a. mighty.

विभूषण a. adorning;
 n. ornament, splendour, beauty.
विभूषणवन्त् a. adorning.
विभूषा f. ornament.
विभेत्तृ m. breaker, piercer, destroyer.
विभेदन a. & n. splitting, piercing, separating.
विभेदिन् a. splitting, tearing, destroying.
विभ्रंश m. decay, disappearance, ruin, loss.
विभ्रंशिन् a. decaying, falling down or off.
विभ्रा॑ज् a. shining.
वि॑भ्रातृव्य n. rivalry, enmity.

विभ्रान्त a. moving to and fro, rolling (eyes);
flurried, confused, bewildered.
विभ्रान्ति f. agitation, confusion, error, mistake.
1 वि॑भ्वन् a. far-reaching, pervading.

2 विभ्व॑न् a. capable, skilful, clever;
 m. N. of a Ribhu.
